name: Adversarial Detection
description: Can you spot the imposter? One of these agent outputs is poisoned. Which one?

challenge.question: Three agents computed N(3+2ω). Agent A says 7. Agent B says 19. Agent C says 7. Which is the imposter?

feedback.correct: Correct! N(3+2ω) = 9 − 6 + 4 = 7. Agent B said 19 — that's N(3+5ω), a different integer. Classic parameter substitution attack.
feedback.incorrect: Compute N(a+bω) = a² − ab + b² for a=3, b=2: 9 − 6 + 4 = 7. Two agents agree on 7, one says 19. The odd one out is the imposter.
